description: This file defines the MethodContext class, which acts as a container for maintaining the state during execution of scripts in a mini-language engine within the Ofbiz framework. It manages various context-related data such as environment variables, request/response objects, user info, locale, timezone, and references to core services like delegator and dispatcher. It includes multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios and methods for getting/setting context data, managing environment variables, and controlling tracing.

classes.name: MethodContext
classes.description: A container for the Mini-language script engine state, managing environment variables, request/response data, user info, and service references during script execution within the Ofbiz framework.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator instance associated with this context.

methods.name: getDispatcher

methods.name: getEnv
